infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NAVIDOOR uses the camera continuously to provide real-time AI spatial guidance, object detection, OCR reading, and pill recognition for visually impaired users.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NAVIDOOR uses the microphone for continuous hands-free voice command navigation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NAVIDOOR uses your GPS location for turn-by-turn walking guidance and emergency SOS location sharing.
